# Playground

Try the springs on a real move, and check how they feel at real speed.

**Kind:** Foundation

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/styles/MotionPlayground.mdx`

## Try a spring

### Stiff and soft

The same menu at the two extremes of the dial. A very stiff spring snaps; a very soft one drifts and makes you wait.

### Your own spring

Pick a token and a mode to load its generated spring, then move stiffness and damping ratio (`damping = 2 × ratio × √(stiffness × mass)`). The curve and the 90% time update with the controls, and playback speed slows the move so you can study it. Anything tuned here is for feel only: to change a token, ask the design team; the numbers in Physics are the only source.

## Feel checks

### The shake

A blocked Save shakes once, at real speed.

### Dragged past a limit

Drag the Panel's edge to the left, past the dashed line (or focus the edge and hold ArrowLeft). Past the limit the Panel follows less and less; on release it springs back with the hand's speed.

### The three Productive speeds

Each on its real job, at real speed.
